purpose: Audit effective join parallelism, not timing; all runs untimed and checked against retained full DuckDB witnesses.
method: Temporary standalone crate reuses unchanged authored queries and workload pipelines. Reexports the original runtime through cq_storage/cq_sequence_tasks aliases; blanket IndexRead proxy records lookup provider, current Rayon slot and active fold/map scope before delegating. fold_tiles/map_parts proxies record callback workers and counts while delegating unchanged runtime scheduling. Slot 0 is the calling thread outside the pool; slots 1..16 are Rayon workers. No compiler/runtime source modifications.
